added.t: For our PEO to sponsor many of its employee benefit plan offerings, it must qualify as the employer of the WSEs under certain provisions of the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA.

In addition, laws and regulations covering marketing, advertising, and email, telephone and text messaging communications, including the Telephone Consumer Protection Act, are applicable to our business.
Our payroll and tax processing services involve the collection, custody and transmission of a significant volume of funds in short-time frames.

removed.t: In addition, the nature of the office environment and remote or hybrid working is changing, which may make it more difficult to attract and retain personnel.
